name: GM1000 book layout standard
basis: GM1000 v4 layout and section structure, with the reviewer-requested Business Case label. This is a formatting standard, not approval of another course's content.

sections.name: Understanding the context
sections.contains: Opening Scenario with a named Business Case, Chapter Roadmap, and course-specific concepts.

sections.name: Developing the concepts
sections.contains: Course-specific explanations, worked examples, and relevant visual models or tables.

sections.name: Applying the concepts
sections.contains: Case Study Progression, Communication Toolbox, and Practical Field Guide.

sections.name: Integrating the concepts at work
sections.contains: Developed synthesis prose, Key Takeaways, Vocabulary Review, Looking Ahead or final Conclusion, and Scholarly Sources.
